gate_type: PLANNING/REVIEW gate — SH-WTP Whole-Plant Federation Expansion Readiness Review (G16)
objective: Produce an evidence-grounded, deterministic expansion-readiness plan for scaling the proven T106->T108 federation toward whole-plant federated execution, WITHOUT implementing any new runtime. Inspect the accepted G10 readiness scope, G11 structural, G12B reference connectivity, G12C admission, G14A projection, G14B federation, G15 evaluation, and the pinned PIM artifacts. Assign exactly one planning decision (NEXT_SLICE_CANDIDATE / LATER_CANDIDATE / STRUCTURAL_ONLY / REFERENCE_ONLY / BLOCKED_PENDING_EVIDENCE) to every reviewed unit with a full decision record (canonical id, VF path, G10 role, evidence, fidelity ceiling, gaps, boundary-contract status, reference-connectivity support, rationale, PIM-decision-before-runtime flag). Provide v0 boundary-contract plans for NEXT/LATER candidates (inputs/outputs/supported properties/synthetic assumptions/unknown-blocking/fidelity ceiling; no runtime code, no fabricated plant parameters). Classify every future projection relation (PROJECTION_CANDIDATE / REFERENCE_ONLY / AMBIGUOUS_BLOCKED / PROJECTED_G14A) with exact PIM relation ids; no BoundaryPort/CompositionBinding creation, no generic FLOWS_TO auto-projection. Produce a whole-plant readiness coverage matrix with whole_plant_runtime = NOT_AUTHORIZED / NOT_IMPLEMENTED, and choose exactly one smallest evidence-safe next slice (or state NO_NEXT_RUNTIME_SLICE_WITH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE). Preserve architecture invariants and authority. No new runtime, ports, bindings, participants, plant-wide execution, T110/Line2/chemical/automation runtime, coupling-policy change, PIM change, or G17.
forbidden_actions: Include T110 runtime or Line2/chemical/electrical/automation runtime
Change coupling policy or G4/G7 semantics
Change PIM or re-pin PIM artifacts
Promote PatternInferred/IndustryExpected entities to runtime candidates
stop_conditions: Selecting a next slice requires a product/physics behavior decision not supported by evidence
A PIM semantic ambiguity must be resolved before candidate selection
Current pins are insufficient and a PIM re-pin/re-export is required
Candidate classification would require changing the frozen fidelity policy
Whole-plant execution would require bypassing explicit boundary/projection gates

acceptance_criteria.description: Source pins match accepted G10/G12B baseline
Every reviewed unit has exactly one decision; all G10 first-slice candidates represented; T106/T108 accepted; T110 blocked; no PatternInferred/IndustryExpected promotion
Every NEXT/LATER candidate has a v0 boundary-contract plan; unknowns explicit; no fabricated site values
Projection candidates reference exact PIM relation ids; no G4 binding created; no generic FLOWS_TO auto-projection
Whole-plant runtime remains NOT_AUTHORIZED / NOT_IMPLEMENTED; authority unchanged
Exactly one next-slice recommendation (not T110) or explicit no-safe-slice result
Complete canonical vNext baseline + G15/G14B-C01/G14B/G14A/G13B/G13/G12C/B/A/G11/G10/G9/G7/G4/G2/G1/ASSY/continuous/UI/full suite green
